bullets.text: AI-Powered Energy Savings - **Tem** raises $75M to transform electricity markets with AI, promising up to 30% savings for UK businesses.
Rugby Meets Tech - **Apple** showcases how England Rugby leverages iPads and Macs for real-time match analysis.
YouTube Music's New Paywall - Lyrics now require a **Premium** subscription, limiting free users to just five views.
Rivian's Apple Watch App - **Rivian** launches an app enabling remote vehicle controls and digital key features for Apple Watch users.
Spotify's Bookstore Expansion - **Spotify** to sell physical books for premium subscribers in the US and UK, diversifying its offerings.
AI Burnout Risks - New research reveals that embracing **AI** can lead to increased burnout among workers, countering productivity claims.
Waymo's Driverless Taxis - **Waymo** tests driverless robotaxis in Nashville, moving closer to launching a ride-hailing service.
MrBeast's Fintech Move - **MrBeast** acquires Step, a banking app aimed at Gen Z, enhancing financial literacy for young users.
ChatGPT Introduces Ads - **OpenAI** begins testing ads in ChatGPT for free users, aiming to support broader access to features.
Lidar Consolidation Continues - **Ouster** acquires StereoLabs, marking a trend of consolidation among perception sensor suppliers.
